# Test classes `swift-regressions` (.github/workflows/apple.yml) executes,
# one per line. Every class here must pass with no skips on macos-latest
# against the staged host archive and the committed synthetic DNG — no
# gitignored RAW fixtures, no required Metal device, no keychain access
# or registered FileProvider domain.
# Everything else is in excluded.txt with a reason;
# tools/check-swift-regressions-coverage.py keeps the two lists complete.
#
